newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BETIS PUT IN OFFER FOR STUTTGART'S BOBIC.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BETIS PUT IN OFFER FOR STUTTGART'S BOBIC.

text.p: Stuttgart captain Fredi Bobic has been made an offer by Spanish club Real Betis which could be worth 20 million marks ($11.6 million), according to press reports on Friday.
"As things are, I haven't the slightest desire to prolong my contract here," the German international striker said in comments published by the Spanish sports daily 'As'.
Bobic, the Bundesliga's top scorer last season, acknowledged that the Spanish side had approached him.
But the article said a Stuttgart official had said Betis had made no offer for the player.
Betis owner Manuel Ruiz de Lopera, who deals with all the club's moves in the transfer market, was not available for comment.
Betis are known to be in the market for a strike partner for Spanish international Alfonso Perez.
